Intro to Real Estate Management: So You Want to Be a Landlord

Before you spend a dollar on a rental, let someone who looks after more than 200 rental doors across DFW honestly try to talk you out of it. Then run the numbers on a real property and decide.

90 minutes · live, small group

What we'll cover

  • What owning a rental actually asks of you, and why it's never as passive as it sounds
  • Running the numbers on a real property, step by step
  • Buy or don't: when a REIT, the stock market, or waiting is the better fit

What you'll walk out with

A completed deal analysis and a clear decision. Buying and not buying both count as a win.

Know before you go

Nothing. Bring a listing you've been eyeing if you have one.

See dates & book

Educational only — not investment, legal, or tax advice. Confirm any purchase with your own lender, CPA, and attorney.

About this class

Who is Intro to Real Estate Management: So You Want to Be a Landlord for?

Women founders who are just starting out — no prior experience assumed. It's part of The Foundations, the plain-language business fundamentals track.

Nothing. Bring a listing you've been eyeing if you have one.

A completed deal analysis and a clear decision. Buying and not buying both count as a win. Every Quinta & Co. class ends with something real you keep.
